import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0]); M = int(data[1]); K = int(data[2])
    P = [0] + [int(x) for x in data[3:3 + K]]
    bt = 3 + K
    rest = data[bt: bt + 3 * M]
    ev = [int(x) - 1 for x in rest[0::3]]
    eu = [int(x) - 1 for x in rest[1::3]]
    et = [int(x) for x in rest[2::3]]
    A = int(data[bt + 3 * M]) - 1
    B = int(data[bt + 3 * M + 1]) - 1

    by_sys = [[] for _ in range(K + 1)]
    for j in range(M):
        by_sys[et[j]].append(j)

    comp_sys = []
    incidences = set()
    parent = {}
    root_comp = {}

    def find(x):
        root = x
        while parent[root] != root:
            root = parent[root]
        while parent[x] != root:
            parent[x], x = root, parent[x]
        return root

    for t in range(1, K + 1):
        ids = by_sys[t]
        if not ids:
            continue
        if len(ids) == 1:
            j = ids[0]
            cid = N + len(comp_sys)
            comp_sys.append(t)
            incidences.add((ev[j], cid))
            incidences.add((eu[j], cid))
            continue
        b = t << 17
        for j in ids:
            v = b | ev[j]
            if v not in parent:
                parent[v] = v
            u = b | eu[j]
            if u not in parent:
                parent[u] = u
        for j in ids:
            rv = find(b | ev[j])
            ru = find(b | eu[j])
            if rv != ru:
                parent[rv] = ru
        for j in ids:
            r = find(b | ev[j])
            cid = root_comp.get(r)
            if cid is None:
                cid = N + len(comp_sys)
                comp_sys.append(t)
                root_comp[r] = cid
            incidences.add((ev[j], cid))
            incidences.add((eu[j], cid))

    n_total = N + len(comp_sys)
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n_total)]
    for v, cid in incidences:
        adj[v].append((cid, P[comp_sys[cid - N]]))
        adj[cid].append((v, 0))

    INF = 1 << 60
    dist = [INF] * n_total
    dist[A] = 0
    MASK = (1 << 20) - 1
    heap = [A]
    push = heapq.heappush
    pop = heapq.heappop
    ans = -1
    while heap:
        pk = pop(heap)
        x = pk & MASK
        d = pk >> 20
        if d > dist[x]:
            continue
        if x == B:
            ans = d
            break
        for y, w in adj[x]:
            nd = d + w
            if nd < dist[y]:
                dist[y] = nd
                push(heap, (nd << 20) | y)

    print(ans)

main()
